<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Message House
- Core positioning statement with 3-5 ranked value propositions
- Per-persona differentiation statements (Weekend Builder, Startup CTO, Privacy-First Builder from Phase 16)
- Lead with developer outcomes, not decentralization

### Architecture-to-Message Mapping
- Map every Gonka technical feature (sessions, tiering, memory, webhooks, Sprint Consensus) to a developer benefit statement
- Use competitive matrix verdicts from Phase 15 to ground claims

### Vocabulary Guidelines
- Define developer-facing language vs internal crypto terminology
- Explicit "never say" list and approved alternatives
- Crypto terms that alienate Web2 developers must be identified and replaced

### Agent-Native Pitch
- Explain why OpenClaw agents themselves would autonomously prefer Gonka
- Technical evidence required (not just marketing claims)

### Objection Handling
- Address top objections per persona with specific responses
- Use journey map objections from Phase 16

### Claude's Discretion
All formatting, document structure, and creative messaging choices at Claude's discretion.

</decisions>
